📦 Supply

How to make a Purchase Order in odoo that needs to be delivered to ANDERLECHT?

This process is to make sure all parts are correctly ordered and each step is followed up correctly.

The target is: to ensure that all parts are delivered on time and in the correct quantity and stored correctly in odoo for proper tracking.

Applicability:

1
All parts that we keep track of the inventory
2
All parts that are sellable to dealers or final clients.

Not applicable to small goods bought on amazon for office operations (coffee, paper, toilette paper, etc)

The first thing to make sure is that for everybody is clear the full INBOUND Supply process:

Let’s breakdown now each of those steps and clarify what needs to be done:

3
To make a purchase order go in the Purchase Application in odoo.
4
Click on NEW.
5
Write the name of the Vendor from who you are purchasing the items. (Note again: All goods purchased including marketing material / R&D material / everything that we keep track of the stock needs to be registered here).
6
At that moment check what odoo tells you about the “on time delivery” - if percentage below 50% consider an extra buffer of time of 15% on top of the usual leadtime that each part from that supplier says.

Since below 50% - remember to add extra time in the expected arrival date.

7
Add the date that based on your deadlines to have the order placed (basically what you are targeting to have the order confirmed – it should not be the same day you do it) . In the example you want to confirm the PO before the 29th May.
8
Write the product name you want to purchase & the quantity.
9
Now check the “expected time of arrival” - this is based on the leadtime we have at product level. (add 15% delay in time if percentage of on time delivery is lower than 50%). In the example we are adding 3 weeks on the general leadtime so from 25/11 of the picture above to 16th December to have some extra buffer / correct info).
10
Add the Vendor Reference, in Vendor Reference you should add as text the “quantity x name of the piece but in a simpler way (ex. Alfine 8 MAX) x POnumber”
11
Add also the project – Project should be the POnumber
12
Go in the Tab other information and add payment terms and incoterms.
13
Make sure the “Deliver to” is correct based on the operation you need to have as receipt:
14
“Ahooga Anderlecht: Receipts” for deliveries to Anderlecht
15
Now you can send the RFQ to the vendor to confirm the price. Click on “Send by email” the RFQ, add to the e-mail also your own personal e-mail xxxx@ahooga.bike in order to have the follow up also via normal e-mail thread.

You are not finished yet, you need to schedule the next activity!!!!

16
Add in the chat the next activity to do: Confirm price. The Due DATE date should be 2 days before the day you are targeting to confirm the PO. Click Schedule.
17
Now in your Purchase APP you will have a reminder of the activity to be done under the column “Activities”.

If the activity to be done is in the future the activity will be in GREEN

If the activity is DUE TODAY the activity will be in ORANGE

If the activity is IN DELAY the activity will be in RED

18
Close to the activity deadline you need to chase the vendor to get price confirmation. When price is confirmed, modify the unit price in the PO order and then confirm the order.
19
Send the PO by E-mail – you can modify the text of the ODOO E-mail.
20
Put the activity in the chat as “DONE”, Odoo will propose your next activity.
21
You will have now in the dashboard of Purchase APP the new activity.
22
Chase the vendor for getting the ETA for the shipment date from their facilities and the arrival at our warehouses. When you get ETA, click on Receipt and add the scheduled date of the Transfer from “vendor” location to “AND / In Transit”.
23
Go back to the purchase order and schedule a new activity: Confirm Shipment date. Schedule this activity at half way between order and ETA they gave you. This will allow you to check with supplier that everything is on time.
24
After confirmation of ETA (if it is kept the same – otherwise change the ETA also in the Receipt delivery) schedule a new Activity on the date of the ETA as “Validate transfer” This will allow you to have an alert when theoretically the shipment should be performed.
25
On the date of the shipment from the Vendor, validate the transfer from “vendor” location to “AND / In Transit”.
26
Set the scheduled date of the transfer from AND/In Transit to the final location.
27
Print the inbound picking operation and put it in the inbound area.
